_what: How much each card says at each step of a pinch on a gallery or board, most first (record-views.tsx detailLevels). Pinching out, Ctrl/Cmd and minus, or Zoom out moves one row down: more, smaller cards that each say less; pinching in moves up. fields is how many of the list's shown fields a card shows under its name (null: every one, 0: the name alone); tile_px is a gallery card's width; words_under_picture keeps the name and fields under a picture instead of the picture alone.
